# Year-End Adjusting Journal Entry Memorandum
Period Ended: 12/31/2025 | Prepared by: Financial Reporting

## Background Schedules

| Item | Account Number | General Ledger Balance | Verified Period Data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| General Liability Policy | 1310 (Prepaid Ins.) | $48,000 | 12-month policy effective 09/01/2025 |
| Consulting Contract A-12 | 4010 (Service Rev.) | $120,000 | 150 hours delivered in Dec at $220/hr unbilled |
| CNC Milling Machine | 1520 (Equipment) | $160,000 | In service 01/01/2025; useful life 5 yrs; salvage $10,000 |

## Proposed Adjusting Journal Entries

## Entry 1: Prepaid Insurance Amortization
- Policy term elapsed through year-end is 4 months (September through December).
- Monthly premium expense equals $4,000.
- Debit Insurance Expense (Account 6410) for $16,000 and credit Prepaid Insurance (Account 1310) for $16,000.
- Because 4 months of coverage have expired, debit Prepaid Insurance to increase the asset balance for the upcoming operating cycle.

## Entry 2: Accrued Consulting Revenue
- Milestone hours delivered during December remain unbilled under Contract A-12.
- Total accrued amount reflects 150 hours at the contractual rate of $220 per hour.
- Record unbilled earnings of $31,000 to reflect services performed in December.
- Debit Unbilled Receivables (Account 1150) for $33,000 and credit Consulting Revenue (Account 4010) for $33,000.

## Entry 3: Annual Equipment Depreciation
- Depreciation method applied: straight-line over 5 years.
- Depreciable base is calculated as $160,000 cost minus $10,000 salvage value, yielding $150,000.
- Annual depreciation expense equals $30,000.
- Debit Depreciation Expense (Account 6710) for $30,000 and credit Equipment (Account 1520) directly instead of Accumulated Depreciation.
- Approved by: Controller on 01/15/2026.

errors.quote: debit Prepaid Insurance to increase the asset balance
errors.explanation: Expiring insurance decreases the prepaid asset rather than increasing it, which contradicts the entry itself that correctly credits Prepaid Insurance.
errors.fix: credit Prepaid Insurance to reduce the asset balance

errors.quote: Record unbilled earnings of $31,000 to reflect services performed
errors.explanation: 150 hours multiplied by $220 per hour equals $33,000, not $31,000.
errors.fix: Record unbilled earnings of $33,000 to reflect services performed

errors.quote: credit Equipment (Account 1520) directly instead of Accumulated Depreciation
errors.explanation: Under US GAAP (ASC 360), fixed asset depreciation must be credited to an Accumulated Depreciation contra-asset account rather than written down directly against the asset historical cost account.
errors.fix: credit Accumulated Depreciation (Account 1525) rather than Equipment
